case_number: 2025 INSC 27; SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (CRL.) No(s). 17781 OF 2024

parties.respondent: The State of Madhya Pradesh & Anr.

summary: Application under Section 319 CrPC to summon accused based on oral evidence of PW3 (first informant) who identified petitioners as participants in murder; closure report exonerating petitioners considered but deemed insufficient to override eyewitness testimony; test for Section 319: strong and cogent evidence, more than prima facie but short of proof beyond reasonable doubt; reliance on Ramesh Chandra Srivastava and Hardeep Singh principles; challenge to non-consideration of closure report rejected; High Court's affirmation of summons upheld.
legal_provisions_cited: Indian Penal Code s.302, s.307, s.147, s.148, s.149, s.120B
final_judgment: Special leave petition dismissed; order of High Court and Trial Court summoning petitioners under Section 319 CrPC upheld.
